name: Melu Managed Live Chat
author: melulivechat

sections.description:
Melu is a managed live chat service that provides live chat software via this plugin, and highly trained professional operators that look after it for you.

Melu is perfect for businesses that don’t have the internal human resources to look after their own live chat, but want the reliability of real people rather than using chatbots.

Melu’s operators are always online and ready to engage with your website visitors 24/7.

Melu is free to try for 14 days – no payment card required!
sections.installation:
Install the Melu plugin directly from the plugins admin section of your WordPress site, or download and install from wordpress.com.

Once the plugin is activated, visit the Melu control panel via the main admin menu on the left and enter your unique product key and click ‘Apply’. This will activate the Melu live chat widget on all pages of your website.

Don’t have a Melu code? Sign-up for your free 14 day trial here – https://meluchat.com/try-melu.
